# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | normalize_whitespace }}

This is the personal engineering blog of {{ site.social.name }}, an IT graduate
based in Sydney, Australia. Every post is a first-hand write-up of something
built, broken or fixed in a real home lab: Proxmox and Docker infrastructure, OPNsense
and VLAN networking, self-hosted services, Linux and Windows administration, and
offensive-security walkthroughs. Posts include the failures and dead ends, not just the
happy path.

Author: [{{ site.social.name }}]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}).
Contact: {% for link in site.social.links %}{{ link }}{% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}
License: content is the author's own; cite with a link to the post URL.

Commands and configurations reflect the software and setup described in each dated article.
